Card Q&A.q: I used this card's [When Digivolving] effect to return an opponent's level 4 Digimon to its owner's hand when my opponent had 7 cards in their hand. My opponent now has 8 cards in their hand, so does the rest of the effect after "Then, if your opponent has 8 or more cards in their hand" also activate?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Return 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to the hand. Then, if they have 8 or more cards in their hand, return 1 of their level 6 or higher Digimon to the hand.
[All Turns][Once Per Turn] When an effect adds cards to your opponent's hand, if you have a Tamer, return 1 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon to the hand.
